morbi.headline: Morbi faces export shocks and rising propane costs despite minor energy price relief.
what_changed: Ceramic exports suffered a Rs 3,589 crore drop over six months due to the war in Iran, though Gulf shipments have recently resumed.
Propane gas prices increased by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg, while natural gas received a Rs 5 price discount.
Local industry leaders represented power, water, and infrastructure issues to the district minister.
stress_signals: War in Iran caused a Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports over six months [19f71f3185bc].
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 per kg to Rs 104/kg [9e8c549b7c05].
Suspicious stock of imported coal discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
Overall export outlook for the cluster remains weak despite resuming Gulf shipments [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices, dropping rates from Rs 82 [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park for ₹1.21 crore [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Export shipment volumes and order book recovery following the resumption of Gulf trade routes.
Margin pressures on units heavily reliant on propane gas versus natural gas.
Government response and policy decisions regarding power, water, and infrastructure representations.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe payment stretch, weaver cutbacks, and diamond downturn despite festive pockets.
what_changed: Weavers in Sayan zone announced a collective vacation cutting fabric production by 60 crore meters over 15 days due to economic distress.
Textile payment cycles have severely extended beyond 200 days ahead of Diwali, triggering trade disputes and weaver protests.
Diamond processing faces dual headwinds from US export demand slumps and rough diamond shortages causing office closures and artisan diversions.
stress_signals: Severe liquidity crisis as textile payment dues cross 200 days, leading to weaver protests and police dispute resolutions [774ba602b06e, 80f44f3f370f, e0787797133b].
Sayan weaving units cutting production by 60 crore meters via collective vacation to cope with financial crisis [297b184838d2].
US demand slump shutting export factories, while Bhavnagar rough diamond shortages shut 800 offices and displace 1 lakh artisans [561255a9240b, f374a30b31ac, 1bcd949a2599].
Weavers' strike caused a single-day drop in power consumption valued at ₹50 crore [3b5a022a3b39].
improvement_signals: Government reduced Textile PLI turnover threshold by 50% and extended the scheme through FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
Surat trade association recovered ₹6 crore in stuck payments for 70 market traders [a523a4bf860d].
Embroidery labor movement ended after an agreement was reached between owners and worker organizations [3a495ae0b3ee].
what_to_watch: Account-level debtor days and receivable aging beyond 180–200 days for MMF synthetic fabric traders and weaving units.
Capacity utilization and power consumption levels post-Sayan vacation and strike resolutions.
Adoption rate of lower-threshold PLI schemes and order realization from trade events like Textile Week-1 and India ITME 2026.
